measurement.angle_convention: PCA major axis: atan2(-dy, dx) modulo 180 degrees; horizontal=0, vertical=90, '/' below 90, backslash above 90. Not individual pen-stroke angles.
measurement.density_denominator: native advance * 17; not padded canvas area
measurement.limits: Connected ink components are not pen strokes. A PCA axis can conceal crossings, hooks or isotropic shapes. Original x=0 / 17px-high measurement canvas may clip overhangs; this is a pinned measurement profile, not an all-font glyph law.
